newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Grafton buys UK builders merchants.
newsitem.headline: Grafton buys UK builders merchants.

text.p: Grafton Group Plc said on Thursday that it had acquired London-based builders merchants Abbey Rose Ltd for a cash consideration of 1.75 million sterling.
The assets acquired include cash of around 700,000 sterling, Grafton said in a statement.
Abbey Rose, a family business operating from Peckham in southeast London, supplies heavyside building materials to a wide customer base in the London area.
It had a turnover of 1.9 million sterling in the year ended December, 1996.
Grafton said the acquisition complemented and strengthened its network of builders merchanting branches in the south of England.
It has spent 11.85 million sterling on acquiring builders and plumbing merchanting businesses since the start of 1997.
